concept.hr: NAS (NFS/SMB) ili SAN (iSCSI/FC): tko vodi datotečni sustav
concept.en: NAS (NFS/SMB) vs SAN (iSCSI/FC): who owns the filesystem

summary.hr: Dva klijenta pišu na NAS i na isti LUN. NAS-ov poslužitelj bira blokove; na SAN-u svaki klijent ima svoju bit tablicu, oba uzmu blok 10 i podaci nestaju.
summary.en: Two clients write to a NAS and to one shared LUN. The NAS server picks the blocks; on the SAN each has its own bitmap, both take block 10 and data is lost.
